question: Related Questions Q. Assalamu alaikum hazraat, I am belongs to Hyderabad and I was given Talaq-e-Bhayyan in present for two witnesses to my wife in Qyazayat Office and deposited iddat amount at Qyazayat office. I already paid mehar amount at time of marriage (same day). She filled false cases DP Act cases on me and my family member. She also filled maintenance (125 Cr.PC) case in our district family count. She was told in the court is, she didn?t get any talaq notice from my side and she is maintainable. My question is: Is she having the write to claim maintenance as per islam and shariyat. If I have pay the maintenance amount to her then it is halal or haram? Please advice as per shariyat. 1867 views Q. My wife calls me beta and mera baccha some times. What is the ruling in shariya for this? What I heard is calling one's husband beta or mera baccha is wrong and one has to pay kaffara for that. The same thing holds good for the husband too, if he calls his wife amma. 12975 views Q. A man was requesting to wife as he was outstation and had been shivering with high fever and malaria his query was to inform his wife over phone that he wants to come back to home due to illness but his wife could not listen attentively by heart and said that no need to come die there. On listening this sentence her husband couldn?t control himself and said Talaq Talaq..Talaq and many times even he told to give phone to your mother and repeated the same many times. But, just after that one of brides family member and guardian asked the groom that did really and intentionally said this words, he replies while weeping out and very brokenly that no his intention was not to give Talaq but punishment to her to change her attitude. Sir, please advise whether this is Talaq or not :- 1. As, he was over phone and from both the sides there was no evidences except her mother and at the place of husband there was no body in evidences. 2. That time her wife was in pregnancy period. 3. That, several times husband tried to meet her but wife never come to meet him. 4. That, they never allowed him to meet with baby girl at the time of birth and after onwards. 5. That, still husband tried a lot to convince them even from local people but worthless. But, now they want to unite in light of holy Quran and Hadith and peace be upon him. Refer to above question, please give us Fatwa accordingly, we would be highly obliged of you. 1799 views Q. Husband doubts me all the time and wants to divorce 2051 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 35550 Country: India Title: My brother in law married a woman who embraced Islam to provide support to her Question: My brother in law married a woman who embraced Islam to provide support to her. My sister was frustrated with this step of his and forced him to give divorce to that woman. That lady was married to some other person (kafir) but did nikah with this lady. Afterwards he gave that lady talaq on phone in presence of my sister. Is that talaq valid? Now he says that he told in-sha-Allah in his mind before saying talaq 3 times and that talaq is invalid. Could you put light on conditions in which talaq remains invalid? Answer ID: 35550 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1861/1316/L=1432) After how many days of her conversion your brother in law married her? Whether she experienced three periods during that or not? Write these points and submit the question again, then in-shaAllah, you shall be replied. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
